props.gloss_en: for the sin of robbery, locusts come up
...and people eat the flesh of their sons and daughters
as it is stated: 'hear this word, you cows of Bashan in the mountain of Samaria, who oppress the poor, who crush the needy' (Amos 4:1)
Rava: [the cows of Bashan are] such as those women of Mechoza, who eat and do not work
and it is written: 'I smote you with blight and mildew; the multitude of your gardens, vineyards, fig and olive trees the gazam devoured' (Amos 4:9)
and it is written: 'what the gazam left the arbeh ate, what the arbeh left the yelek ate, what the yelek left the chasil ate' (Joel 1:4)
and it is written: 'one snatches on the right and is hungry, eats on the left and is not satisfied; they eat every man the flesh of his arm' (Isa 9:19)
'they eat every man the flesh of his arm' (Isa 9:19), read as the flesh of his offspring -- the source for eating one's children
do not read 'the flesh of his arm' (besar zero'o) but 'the flesh of his offspring' (besar zar'o) (אל תקרי)
